toolchain.note: Mandated MINIMUMS for this repo and every consuming remote — see the 'Toolchain baseline' section of CLAUDE.md. FuzeFront is the Module-Federation host, so moduleFederationRequiredVersion must be identical here and in every remote or the remote loads its own React copy and fails with 'Invalid hook call'. Raising the floor is fine; lowering it is a breaking change to the family. Declarative only — no CI gate reads this today.

identity.note: Prefix namespace for this product's entity types (governance/identifier-standard.md §2, baseline v1.5.0). DECLARED here rather than derived from the repo directory name: a rename would otherwise silently orphan every id already issued, and that surfaces much later as unresolvable references with no obvious cause. FuzeFront mints only RESERVED SPINE prefixes (usr/org/prt/app, the billing set, the messaging set) because it hosts those services for the whole family — a product's own types namespace as front_<type>. Enforced by `gate_identifier.py --namespace`, whose spine table names the owning repo per prefix.

acceptance: Every default-branch build publishes a signed, verified APK to GitHub Releases.
The APK launches the standalone UI at https://app.fuzefront.com/ and the UI uses same-origin relative /api routes.
The TWA host, Android package, and Digital Asset Links identity remain consistent.

mcp.note: GATEWAY dialect — the shared @fuzefront/mcp-gateway image (packages/mcp-gateway, published by this repo), not per-repo server code. TWO gateways: (1) fuzefront-mcp fronts the app-registry contract (20 tools, always-on); (2) selection-list-mcp fronts the selection-list-service contract (25 tools, ships dark — both selectionListService.enabled AND selectionListsMcp.enabled must be true). Both use the same image; what distinguishes each pod is its mounted OpenAPI spec + overrides pair. The app-registry gateway is exposed publicly via Ingress (values-prod.yaml mcp.ingress.enabled=true); the selection-list gateway is ClusterIP-only. Both forward the caller's bearer token and hold no credential of their own. Spec copies in deploy/helm/fuzefront/files/ must stay in sync with their sources — run scripts/check-mcp-spec-drift.sh. toolCount = 20 (app-registry) + 25 (selection-list). Owned by mcp-maintainer for upkeep of this block/deployment wiring; tool behaviour is owned by backend-engineer.
